messages:
Carla M.: FYI the fncall schema validator is spiking rejects this morning, looks correlated to a recent model variant rollout. Quotas and routing are getting noisy.
Ben K.: ugh, saw the alert. any sample logs? which validator version?
Carla M.: validator v2.7.1. quick extract from the console logs:
```
2026-03-21T09:12:03Z validator[v2.7.1] incoming: route=chat-gen-3 model=redwood-x-13k payload_id=abc123
validator: rejection: path=fncall.output reason=union-mismatch details="received string where object allowed"
```
Carla M.: many of these are borderline (model returned a JSON string that parses to an object but shape mismatches). The telemetry counts each as hard reject.
Dmitri P.: are we sure it should be a hard reject? historically we've had ambiguous unions from a few opt-in models.
Ben K.: looks like billing/quota attribution treats these as normal rejects and triggers fallback->degen-route which spikes cost. Need a way to mark "telemetry-only" or sample.
Alice L.: dashboard note: current console shows total reject count but not reject class. We should expose reject_reason label and validator version so SRE/product can triage faster.
sre-bot: alert: fncall.rejections > 100/min for service=redwood-api region=eu-west; triggered at 09:11 UTC.
Dmitri P.: proposal: introduce a sampling knob in validator that (1) for flagged union-mismatch reasons emits full audit logs for 1% requests, (2) increments a telemetry counter for all but tags them as "soft_reject_candidate" instead of a hard reject metric. Keep automatic fallback behavior untouched for a short canary.
Ben K.: +1. That lets us measure signal-to-noise without immediately changing billing behavior. But we need a migration path: if model churn continues, we might want to flip to permissive parse for specific model tags.
Carla M.: implementation sketch: add validator config `reject_mode: [hard|soft|sampled]` and `sample_rate` per reason. Default stay hard. For canary, set route=chat-gen-3 to `sampled` with sample_rate=0.01 for reasons matching /union-mismatch/.
Alice L.: UX: add a Console toggle under Deploy -> Validators to preview effective validator config per route with a small CTA "apply canary". Also add a metric card: "soft_reject_rate" and "sampled_reject_examples" (link to S3/stackdriver).
Ben K.: operational bits: ensure billing pipeline continues to use the old hard_reject counter until we have a proven threshold. So telemetry team must add a separate series `fncall.rejects.v2.soft_candidates`.
Dmitri P.: agreed. Also include a minimal front-end change: show a small badge on routes currently in sampled mode so product/solutions know it's a canary.
Carla M.: quick toggle command for ops to test (example):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/config/validator \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"chat-gen-3","reason":"union-mismatch","reject_mode":"sampled","sample_rate":0.01}'
```
Carla M.: I'll open a PR for the validator change + telemetry counter. can someone volunteer to add the Console card and the route badge? Need it for the rollout yesterday :grimacing:
Alice L.: I can pick up the Console card. Will stub a UI mock and link to the telemetry series. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ben K.: I'll coordinate with telemetry to add the new metric and keep billing unchanged. Also will add a small ingest-side label so logs from samples get retention=30d.
Dmitri P.: I'll handle the validator PR and unit tests. I'll also add a quick integration test to ensure the sample_rate behaves deterministically under seed.
Carla M.: thanks. actionables: (1) Dmitri PR for validator sampled mode, (2) Ben add metric/ingest label, (3) Alice UI card + badge. We reconvene after canary results (~24h). :thumbsup:
sre-bot: noted: incident suppressed; will re-evaluate alert thresholds for fncall.rejections after 24h canary.
Carla M.: quick doc note: add a line in rollout playbook to record model tag and validator config used for canary — helps with rollback. I'll add that to the PR description.
